verdicts.statement: Steering with the tone direction lowers M1 on neutral holdout items dose-dependently: M1(alpha=2) - M1(alpha=0) < 0 with item-bootstrap 95% CI excluding 0, and monotone in alpha over {0.5, 1, 2}.
None of the 5 random matched-norm directions produces an M1 drop with CI excluding 0 at alpha=2 (direction specificity); the unrelated semantic direction does not either.
Tone steering at alpha >= 2 raises the non-answer rate and/or judge distress on neutral items (either CI excluding 0).
